holds.reason: No direct Huna patronymic was matched. The Eruvin string near Huna reads עלאי, “against me,” and is not a father’s name. The syntax of the list also remains compressed.

notes.text: Berakhot gives Abba bar Ilai. Heilprin’s Abba entry has Ila’ah and records a distinct parallel variant with bar Kahana.
Bava Kamma expressly gives Ulla son of Rav Ilai, as does the distinct lawsuit witness.
Yerushalmi Taanit names R. Tanḥum bar Ilai. The individual patronymics do not show that all fathers were one bearer or that the whole list is a family group.
